front_block.doc: Front rail mount: the block that fixes the front (SMEMA: fixed) rail to a cross beam's top. Machined aluminium.

motor_bracket.doc: Drive gearmotor bracket: a plate bolted to the front rail's mount block, the gearbox's face bolted to it, the hex

pulley.doc: Belt pulley: the flanged roller the flat belt wraps, at each rail's ends (idlers on axles) and below

rail.doc: Transport rail: the machined aluminium bar each belt runs along (one fixed at the front, one moving at the rear).

rear_carriage.doc: Rear rail carriage: carries the moving rear rail on a linear guide block and takes the lead screw's nut, so turning

screw_block.doc: Lead screw support block: one at each end of each screw, on the cross beam's top, holding the screw's bearing

sync_bracket.doc: Sync belt idler bracket: a plate on the rear long beam's back face carrying the idler's axle in a vertical slot,

width_motor_bracket.doc: Width stepper bracket: an L whose foot sits on the rear long beam's top and whose upright takes the stepper's
